items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: Ernest Opanyo was the head drummer... Ernest Opanyo was always the original drum player of the tuxedo band... I went over and took the play.

ctx.x: Did you ever play many of the places in the district? Did you ever play at that old tuxedo dance hall? Yeah.
Played at the tuxedo hall. That's when the boys made the band up. But Ernest Opanyo was the head drummer.
